# Closed constructor inputs containing reifiable carriers

A constructor delegates through a virtual getter into an overloaded
constructor accepting a complete Map of a nested all-wildcard key and an
upper Object value. The key contributes no formal binding. Frozen external
observers check getter order, overload selection, original Map identity,
partial final fields, exact failures, live value reads and late casts.
Source and imported-declaration modes compare 64 JVM cases twice, retain all
original metadata, and reject Signature-only and compiled counterexamples.

The recovery report selects the Java release needed for constructor prefixes.
The runner recompiles at that release and records any resulting class-file
version change separately from unchanged original declaration metadata.
